item.title: Vans' Stunning Slip-On Boat Shoe Skates On Water
item.description: Vans' beautiful boat shoe is so normal in its simplicity, it might be the strangest thing Vans has ever done.

item.title: Balthazar Is Very Frenchly Getting Into Fashion (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Balthazar's first fashion partnership is timed to NYFW but it's actually quite French, as the famous SoHo eatery teams with Ami Paris on an extensive collab.

item.title: CAMPERLAB's Twisted Dad Shoe Is Intentionally Rough Around The Edges
item.description: CAMPERLAB's Tornado trail sneaker is a dad shoe with some super serious punk-rock steez.

item.title: When the Artist Met the All-Star
item.description: The artist and the New York Knicks star talk fine art, jump shots, and the synergy that brought them together.

item.title: Public School Says Its Nikes "Are a Metaphor" for Its Comeback (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Public School New York, the lauded NYC fashion brand, is back in a big way & its collaborative Nike & Jordan sneakers are a symbol of its revival.

item.title: Who Knew New Balance's Retro Dad Runner Would Look So Pretty in Pink?
item.description: The New Balance Made in UK 991v2 Polignac eschews muted hues for dusty pink and silver, showing a bolder side to a timeless, dad shoe-recalling silhouette.

item.title: sacai Made Leather Bags Out of Historic English Notebooks
item.description: In 1887, Smythson started making notebooks. A few years later, supple leather bags. Now, in 2026, sacai is bringing the two practices together.

item.title: The Collina Strada Converse Is So Extreme It Barely Looks Like a Converse
item.description: Converse's Chuck Taylor shoe is near-unrecognizable in Collina Strada Fall/Winter 2026. Quite an achievement considering it's such a well-recognized shoe.

item.title: Pirouette Away In Nike's Red-Hot & Romantically Ribbon-Tied Sneakerina
item.description: Having only been previewed so far, the Jordan Pointe has already been revealed in a range of colorways. Most recently, a duet of Black and Chile Red.

item.title: Nike's Ultra-Luxe Habanero Skate Shoe Is Almost Too Spicy
item.description: Paul Rodriguez's Nike SB Zoom Air skate shoe is a fire thrasher that's almost too luxe to shred in.
